name: messenger-desktop
description: A lightweight macOS wrapper for Facebook Messenger

scripts.install-app: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),os=require('os');const arch=os.arch()==='arm64'?'mac-arm64':'mac';const src=path.join(__dirname,'dist',arch,'Messenger.app');const dst=path.join(os.homedir(),'Applications','Messenger.app');if(!fs.existsSync(src)){console.log('❌ App not found. Run npm run build first.');process.exit(1);}if(fs.existsSync(dst)){fs.rmSync(dst,{recursive:true,force:true});}fs.cpSync(src,dst,{recursive:true});console.log('✅ Messenger.app installed to Applications folder!');"

author: Leo
